highlights: Save seed can take seed from several plants into one jar: tap Add seed from another plant. If the plants are different varieties, the jar is filed as a named mix, for example Jewel + Alaska mix
A saved jar's page lists every plant its seed came from. You can add a plant or remove one, with Undo, and the jar re-files itself to match
You can note about how many plants the seed came off
Saved seeds cards show Mixed seed and how many plantings a jar came from, and a planting's page says which other plants its jar was mixed with
